'''TechTank''' was a small [[Outlaw tech/Legends|outlaw tech]] gang that operated in a [[TechTank shop|concealed shop]] on the lower levels of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The gang was led by the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Tennom]] and it secretly allied itself with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Sinasu]]. After Sinasu became embroiled in a gang war with the rival Hutt [[Noako]], Sinasu took shelter among TechTank in their Nar Shaddaa base. However, the gang subsequently fell under attack by [[Cordol's Chain]], a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] group that had been hired by Noako.
